issues.title: Murkomen reassures Kenyans of security amid fears of goons’ menace
issues.title_en: Murkomen reassures Kenyans of security amid fears of goons’ menace
issues.summary: Interior Cabinet Secretary Kipchumba Murkomen has assured Kenyans that the country remains secure despite growing concerns over political violence and the use of goons during political rallies.
